review_basis: Hand-traced in the running canvas app's Linear tool (manual mode, scale confirmed from the plan's own detected '1/8" = 1'-0"' note) via a Playwright-driven browser session against the rendered PDF. The two parallel 4" chilled-water lines were each independently identified by real-world coordinate: pdf.ts's positionedText locates the separate 'CHWR' (x=3985) and 'CHWS' (x=4003) callouts printed directly beside this riser pair (distinct from -- and more specific than -- the combined '4" CHWS/R PIPING DOWN...' arrow-leader note above them), and each traced click was cross-checked live against the canvas app's own status-bar real-world readout (x=222'0" for the CHWS line, x≈221'0" for the CHWR line, ~1 ft apart, matching the labels' own relative offset) before committing -- not inferred from on-screen proximity alone.
scope: This federal ground-floor HVAC piping sheet (M3.1) is dense with heating-hot-water (HHWS/HHWR) branch piping to dozens of VAV reheat coils, plus this one chilled-water (CHWS/CHWR) riser pair feeding chiller CH-1. WP3.8 asks for a representative run here, not an exhaustive trace of the sheet. This golden is the 4" CHWS/CHWR riser pair itself: traced from just below the 'PIPING DOWN THROUGH SLAB TO CH-1' callout, straight down to the point marked 'BELOW GRADE' where the lines leave the building envelope. Both lines are uniform 4" nominal pipe for their full traced extent -- no size change, no fitting, a clean straight vertical pair, chosen specifically because (unlike the ITD p5 golden in this same directory) each line carries its own unambiguous, independently-labeled supply/return identity. Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for this golden: the entire HHWS/HHWR branch network to every VAV box on this sheet, the CHWS/CHWR run's own continuation below grade toward the chiller utility enclosure ('SEE BELOW', off this immediate view), and every other mechanical room / equipment connection this dense sheet shows -- all left for a later, broader ground-truth pass.

runs.description: 4" chilled-water supply (CHWS) riser, from the top of its 'PIPING DOWN THROUGH SLAB TO CH-1' callout straight down to the 'BELOW GRADE' transition point.
4" chilled-water return (CHWR) riser, running parallel to the CHWS riser (~1 ft west of it) from the same 'PIPING DOWN THROUGH SLAB TO CH-1' callout down to its own 'BELOW GRADE' transition point.
